name: Region title: image-filled title
when: A region chapter starts, when you have a bright still of the region (a sunset skyline). Big white letters rise, then the white drains out of each letter to show the still inside them.
anchor: The letters start rising at 0.22 s and are in at 0.75 s; the drain runs from 0.88 s to 1.74 s. Start the scene just before the voice names the region.

vars.title: the region's name, in capitals as validated ("VICE CITY"); 10 characters at most
vars.tagline: one line under it, in sentence case ("The sun and fun capital of America."); empty = none
vars.fill: the still inside the letters: a bright, wide image in the project's assets/ (validated: a 1500x352 sunset skyline band). Required. It is drawn 1500 px wide from 110 px down and drifts left 70 px a second; a dark still makes the letters unreadable
vars.dim: true (default) = the template brings its own left dim, in from 0 s and out 0.15 s after `out`; false when the scene under it already dims the left side, as the map chapter does under its postcard (the validated layering: dim, then postcard, then title)
vars.out: seconds after the start: when the title starts to leave (at least 2.0). The scene ends 0.45 s later

changed: The title layer only: the map, its camera, the region outline, the flash, the postcard and the left dim under the postcard are the map scene's. The template can bring that left dim itself (`dim`, on by default) so the title reads on any map or shot; when it does, the dim leaves in 0.3 s instead of 0.35 s (exit 0.3 s at most), and it sits above whatever the scene under it shows. The still is a file variable, drawn 1500 px wide at its own ratio (the validated 1500x352 still gives the same picture), and keeps drifting at the validated rate when the scene is longer.
